items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Olly is ill. He had a pace-maker and he had to get it replace, the first one didn't work. I talked to him just before coming down here, I'm going to meet with him on Saturday.
I will do that, I figured that you two were very close. You just had him down here in October, he talked about that.
